```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)


file_ids <- c(
  "2024" = "1IjIEhLc9n8eLKeY-yh_YigKVWbhgGBsN",
  "2025" = "1v6LRphp2kYciU4SXp0PCjEMuev1bDejc",
  "2026" = "1hnpbrUpBMS1TZI7IovfpKeZfWJH1Aptm"
)

dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (year in names(file_ids)) {
  url <- paste0("https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=", file_ids[[year]])
  download.file(url, destfile = paste0("data/raw/", year, ".csv"), mode = "wb")
}

library(readr)
library(purrr)

lol_data <- list.files("data/raw", full.names = TRUE) |> map_dfr(read_csv)
dim(lol_data)
```
